mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month (computed from FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS decline are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPI index above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, which triggers central bank hawkishness and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is low (UNRATE < 3.5%) and housing starts are rising (HOUST > 1500.0), it signals strong consumer demand and tight labor market conditions, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 3.5% AND HOUST > 1500.0), or the interaction term in a regression has a coefficient not significantly different from zero (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a higher federal funds rate compresses corporate profit margins and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals a tight labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 3.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1500.0) signals strong residential construction and consumer confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST > 1500.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO > 105.0) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO > 105.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) are rising and the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%), it signals strong consumer spending and accommodative monetary policy, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand with low rates
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances (RSAFS > 700000.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 4.5%), or the interaction term in a regression has a coefficient not significantly different from zero (p > 0.05).
